name: Jan Toorop
bio: Johannes Theodorus "Jan" Toorop was a Dutch painter who worked in various styles, including Symbolism, Art Nouveau, and Pointillism. His early work was influenced by the Amsterdam Impressionism movement.

paintings.title: Lady in White (Toorop)
paintings.story: Lady in White  is an impressionist painting of a woman wearing a white robe, from 1886, by Dutch painter Jan Toorop.
facts: In Toorop's Lady in White from the end of 1886, he still seems to be inspired by Whistler more emphatically than in the other portrait he made of Annie called Portrait of Annie Hall in Lissadell.
The painting shows an intense, almost plain white colour on the woman's robe, contrasted with dark tones in the background, in an almost monochrome color palette.

paintings.title: Broek in Waterland (painting)
paintings.story: Broek in Waterland is an 1889 oil painting by Dutch-Indonesian artist Jan Toorop, located in the Indianapolis Museum of Art in Indianapolis, Indiana. It is a pointillist image of the Dutch village of Broek in Waterland at twilight.
